title: arctostaphylos glandulosa var. howellii
intro: Arctostaphylos glandulosa var. howellii, commonly known as Howell's manzanita, is a subspecies of the manzanita plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This shrub is native to California and is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Howell's manzanita are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
